Eve: PSA — if your semver looks like `v1.0.alpha` the CI calls it "abstract art" and refuses to ship. :art:
Carlos: wait, that's a feature not a bug. we ship art. :sunglasses:
Sam: lol no. the linter literally yelled at my commit: 
Sam: ```
ERROR: version 'v1.0.alpha' does not match pattern ^v\d+\.\d+\.\d+$
```
Eve: also i found this gem in a YAML today: `-settings:
	logging: true` 
Eve: tabs plus hyphen-plus-key. the parser had an existential crisis. :exploding_head:
ci-bot: build #4821 failed — YAMLError: sequence entry without proper indentation at line 1
Carlos: pro tip: never mix tabs and spiritual wellbeing.
Sam: can we have a "bring your own linter" day? i will bring sarcasm and a regex.
Eve: we should add a small RFC: "When in doubt, semver it out" and a webhook that converts vibes into patch releases. :robot_face:
ci-bot: Suggested fix: update version to `v1.0.0` and replace tabs with two spaces. Automated commit available: https://ci.example/4821/fix
Carlos: taking the automated commit. brownie points if the commit message contains the word 'apocalypse'. :brownie:
Sam: commit message: "rescue YAML from the void (apocalypse edition)" :tada:
Eve: glorious. also pinned to the team board: "YAML Etiquette 101". attendance is optional, tears are not. :joy:
